easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Gruul Turf
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
